scope: Proposition 5.4 (Finite schedule of simultaneous exclusions) of the manuscript “Finite congruence lattices: characterization and undecidability” (preprints/Finite-Congruence-Lattices-Characterization-and-Undecidability-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 206 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d26d6cd6285de4f2), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 28. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Suppose that the local exclusions below prohibit their prescribed failed patterns with absolute case and chart-loss bounds. For a bounded path length, finitely many rounds then produce a flat of final increment r such that the subgroup label of every proper extension in it is contained in none of the prescribed proper full stabilizers relative to any high-type ancestor. The next local simple has the corresponding transitivity or full-spanning properties relative to all those ancestors.
